text:
Ava: lunchtime detour 10 — someone left the office door open and a tiny alpaca wandered into the lobby. pictures: alpaca_hat_01.jpg, alpaca_hat_02.jpg https://imgur.com/alpaca_hat 
Luis: wait wut. an alpaca. in our lobby. are we in a fairytale or did i miss an event? :exploding_head: 
Ava: no event. just very calm, very judgemental alpaca. also it wore a tiny knit hat.
Kei: this is peak content. please 4K photos or it didn't happen :camera_with_flash:
Ava: uploading hi-res `alpaca_hat_01.jpg` and a short clip `lobby_approach.mp4` 1https://imgur.com/alpaca_vid
Nora: also a question: do alpacas accept snacks? asking for a coworker 
Luis: only if you want a long stare and possibly a spit warning. :yum:
Ava: bribed with a rogue granola bar. it sniffed, accepted, then sat on the welcome mat like it owned the place :crown:
Kei: "owned the place" is my new verb. official team emoji submission: :alpaca_coworker: ?
sticker-bot: :alpaca: sticker added
Nora: poll: should we actually contact facilities to see if this is from the farmer's market next door or just a mascot escapee? react :thumbsup: for yes, :thumbsdown: for no
Luis: +1 to check. i don't want a stampede when someone brings coffee.
Kei: +1. also +1 to creating an "Alpaca Lobby" status channel 
Ava: placed a quick sign: "temporary guest: alpaca. please be kind." put in #general too.
Nora: naming suggestions? "Sprocket" and "Mochi" have been proposed.
Luis: mmm Mochi vibes. also taking bets on whether it will nap under the ficus.
Ava: update at 13:42: alpaca politely escorted to facilities by campus security and is now (apparently) on a scheduled farm tour this afternoon. they said its name might be "Pickle".
Kei: conclusion: 1) our office is magical 2) i demand more hat photos 3) we should have an annual Pet Surprise Day.
Nora: awarding "Most Unexpected Visitor" badge to the alpaca. @everyone send hat designs.
Ava: plus one on hat designs. i'll DM design. end of thread.
